messages:
mira_s: Quick heads-up — CumulusSys and Marketplace team confirmed the joint "Deep Dive: Integrations & Ops" webinar for May 12. Need to lock run-of-show, speaker order, a demo fallback, and swag shipping plan.

leah_p: Awesome. Can we do a 30m dry run w/ all speakers the week before? I can do May 5 or May 6 afternoons (PDT).

alex_k: May 6 3pm PDT works for me. I'll run network checks and shared-screen flow.

pete_r: I can take the demo fallback. Suggest we prepare a pre-recorded short clip if live model latencies spike.

jordan_m: +1 on pre-record. Also can we get a Marketplace tile screenshot for the slides? Cumulus says they need final logo by April 28.

mira_s: Noted. Leah, can you nudge marketing for the logo ASAP? I'll add the runbook items.

ops-bot: Reminder: create session in #eng-oncall for webinar day to route any infra issues.

leah_p: Added to ops checklist. Draft run-of-show below — open to edits:
```
15:00 — Host intro (3m)
15:03 — CumulusSys overview (8m)
15:11 — Redwood demo: Marketplace + Provisioning flow (12m)
15:23 — Joint Q&A (10m)
15:33 — Closing + CTA (2m)
```

alex_k: For Redwood demo, I'll show provisioning via marketplace, then attach a short script to simulate heavy traffic. Can we reserve a small dedicated cluster for rehearsal?

mira_s: Yes — requesting a 2-GPU sandbox on Dedicated for May 6 rehearsal (tag: partner-demo-05-06).

pete_r: Swag plan: 200 sticker packs + 150 microfiber sleeves + 50 partner-branded charger blocks. Shipping to CumulusSys HQ and three speaker addresses. SKU RW-SWAG-2026. Carrier preference: FedEx Priority for international.

jordan_m: Shipping addresses please. I'll upload labels to the shared drive.

leah_p: Speaker addresses (DMed). For on-site pickup at CumulusSys booth, ops contact is @ana_cumulus. I'll cc them on the shipping manifest.

mira_s: Demo fallback checklist (short):
- pre-recorded 3-min clip uploaded to S3 (path: s3://redwood-partners/cumulus/deepdive/prebake.mp4)
- presenter's local recording enabled as backup
- streaming test at T-30m to validate bitrate

alex_k: Can we include the quick command to spin the provisioned demo in the runbook?

leah_p: Adding snippet:
```bash
# spin demo env
redwoodctl deploy --team=partners --cluster=partner-demo-05-06 --image=marketplace-integration:stable
```

mira_s: Perfect. Last items: who will handle the joint press blurb (short announcement) after the webinar? Marketing or partnerships?

jordan_m: Marketing leads the blurb but Partnerships will draft the first version. I'll take first pass, aim to share by April 30.

pete_r: One more: AV note — ask CumulusSys to confirm presenter laptop HDMI adapters early. We had an issue last time.

leah_p: Good call. I'll send a quick AV checklist to speakers and Ana.

mira_s: OK — action items summary:
- Leah: schedule dry run May 6 3pm PDT + AV checklist (due Apr 28)
- Alex: reserve 2-GPU sandbox + build pre-record clip (due May 3)
- Pete: finalize swag manifest & ship (labels by May 1)
- Jordan: draft press blurb (due Apr 30)
- Mira: collate runbook, create #eng-oncall session for May 12

mira_s: If no objections I'll lock this plan by EOD and ping marketing + Cumulus contacts. :thumbsup:
